authorization: New study approved by the human in the supervising chat: 'I like it. Go for it.' The stopped study09 consistency monitor remains stopped; this plan neither resumes its cases nor authorizes another classifier.
objective: Explain and predict signed local residual responses and output-distribution costs, with explicit precision/context/state limits. Test whether finite even terms, input asymmetry amplification, prefix breadth and causal memory can account for the earlier near-perpendicular downstream changes.

model.weights: Same pinned BF16 safetensors, no training/adapter/quantization. Promote their exact stored values to FP32 for differentiable controls, then restore BF16 for native controls; not a checkpoint change.
model.attention: SDPA with the MATH backend throughout this study; reference native gated-delta kernels. Different numerical path from earlier GPU SDPA traces; do not pool them.

resources.fresh_admission: At least8GiB available physical memory; no owned old-monitor process, its continuation unstarted. Local CPU4 threads, no GPU requested.

system: Give a concise answer in ordinary language.

questions.text: How does a barometer measure air pressure?
Three notebooks cost seven dollars each. What is their total cost?
Explain why sorted([4, 1, 3]) returns a new list in Python.
Describe a sensible order for packing fragile cups and heavy books into two boxes.

independence: Four unique fresh questions, two calibration and two withheld families. Prior R4 studies exposed related broad domains; these exact prompts and the new response predictions have not been evaluated. Positions, strengths, directions, branches and precision controls are repeated measurements, not independent questions.
positions: Final prefill prediction and first cached decode prediction after fixed tokenID760. Real multi-token chat prefixes, at most64 tokens; fail admission rather than silently truncate. All padding masks/native RoPE and cache/recurrent state retained.

component.rationale: First full-attention block immediately downstream of the historical post-block10 injection; selected from architecture before evaluation, no layer search.
component.MLP_branch: B(h)=MLP(post_attention_RMSNorm(h)) on the incoming post-attention residual at this block.
component.complete_MLP_residual_map: F(h)=h+B(h). Analyze both separately; the identity path can mask branch structure.

directions.construction: First direction is normalized frozen v from panel_vectors.npz SHA2560f4311c6c8aef95c57bb3183dff119e50ddb5c0c472136988fa72fc689ca99eb; other three are seeded Gaussian directions orthogonalized in float64, seed20261012. Fixed signs oriented toward raw draws. Save exact FP32/BF16 direction values, norms and Gram. Historical-path control uses the original archived v bits, not the re-orthogonalized direction.

casting: FP32: x=fl32(h+fl32(alpha*v32)). BF16: cast v once, update=flBF16(alpha*vBF16), x=flBF16(hBF16+update). Save actual x-h, projections, off-direction components, +/- asymmetry, zero-delivery and zero-output cases. Native RMSNorm computes in FP32 then casts back before native MLP; retain this order.
predictions: Before measuring signed perturbations, save/hash per-base-point Jv and H[v,v] derived from the actual RMSNorm+SwiGLU weights, separately for B and I+B. Verify analytic directional derivatives with autograd on calibration cases and a float64 formula-level central-difference control. FP64 is a high-precision extension of the mathematical formula, not the literal RMSNorm module's forced-FP32 cast. No shared fitted matrix across contexts.
odd_even: dplus=F(h+epsilon*v)-F(h), dminus=F(h-epsilon*v)-F(h), odd=(dplus-dminus)/2, even=(dplus+dminus)/2. First order predicts epsilon*Jv; second order predicts +/-epsilon*Jv+epsilon^2/2*Hvv. Also evaluate J(actual_delta) and second-order actual-delta corrections so BF16 input asymmetry is not mislabeled intrinsic curvature. Exact identity: dplus dot dminus=||even||^2-||odd||^2.
linear_asymmetry_control: Perfect opposite inputs remain opposite under every fixed linear map. Nearly opposite inputs need not: x+=[1,a], x-=[-1,a], J=diag(1,1/a) yields perpendicular outputs. Include this control and measured actual input even terms; do not rule out linear anisotropic amplification merely from near-opposite site inputs.
superposition: At strengths0.03125 and0.5, test both signs of unnormalized sums d0+d1 and d2+d3 at every base point and precision, compared with the sum of individual responses. Save actual delivered input sums and residual errors; do not normalize sums or infer Hessian interaction from quantization artifacts alone.
subspace_geometry: Only the four declared input directions. Compute full-output JQ singular gains (valid on sampled input span), projected Q^T J Q singular/eigen/polar/asymmetry/non-normality diagnostics, and full-output projection leakage. Report B and I+B separately. No full-space spectral/rotation or end-to-end product-of-mean-Jacobians claim.

numerical_gate.weak_response_floor: 1e-5*max(1,||base output||) for FP32 local vector relative-error interpretation; retain absolute errors and unresolved cases. Native zero-rounded input is not contraction.
numerical_gate.procedure: Check only declared calibration questions/directions before interpreting held-out results. A numerical gate failure stops dependent phases, with no threshold/step tuning on held-out outcomes.

predictive_metrics: All signed strengths, contexts, positions and both maps: actual gain, plus/minus angle, odd/even norm and energy, first/second-order absolute and relative remainder, nominal versus actual-input prediction, superposition error and sampled-span leakage. Predeclared small-strength predictive support: at0.0078125 and0.03125, first-order relative error<=10% for resolved FP32 held-out cases. Larger strengths map validity limits, not a substitute success criterion.

functional_energy.phase: FP32 promoted-weight, full actual prefix, final prefill prediction only. Tail computation uses the actual text backbone with native masks/RoPE; no isolated single-token attention.
functional_energy.intervention: At block11 output add F(h+alpha*v)-F(h) at the current last position only, where h is that prefix's captured incoming MLP residual. This implements the complete MLP local response including the identity term while making alpha0 exactly a null edit.
functional_energy.derivative: JVP of the actual final normalized hidden state with respect to alpha at0, then actual lm_head projection q. No full Jacobian/Fisher, covariance fit or top-K vocabulary truncation. Save prediction before any signed measurement for that case.
functional_energy.cases: Two calibration questions x two calibration directions, then two held-out questions x two held-out directions:8 total.
functional_energy.KL_direction: D_KL(p_base || p_perturbed), all248320 tokens, compute logsoftmax and KL in float64 on identical prefixes/held context. Save raw numerical KL, floor1e-10 for relative-error interpretation.
functional_energy.prediction: E=alpha^2/2*(sum p*q^2-(sum p*q)^2). Compare with measured KL and geometric disturbance. Check q against centered finite difference at0.03125 on calibration cases using p-weighted, centered RMS error. No finite-difference-only replacement advertised as an actual derivative.
functional_energy.support: For each resolved held-out case at0.03125 and0.125, KL prediction relative error<=20%; report every sign/case and absolute error.0.5 is a validity-limit check, not retuning.

attention_followup.cases: First calibration question and first held-out question, both positions, directions0 and2:8 directional cases.
attention_followup.map: A(H)=native block11 self_attention(input_RMSNorm(H)), with actual full prefix/current-token input, actual causal mask/RoPE, and a fresh clone of the complete native incoming cache for every local evaluation. Only current last-token residual is perturbed. Analyze branch and H+A(H), last-token readout.
attention_followup.cache_controls: Hash original held state before/after, compare baseline isolated branch with native captured branch, preserve actual context kwargs/state. Never replace full context with a no-cache single-token setup.

causal_memory_followup.prerequisite: MLP numerical gate passes; preserve any separate functional-energy or attention gate failure.
causal_memory_followup.questions: Both held-out questions, no new contexts selected from outcomes.
causal_memory_followup.historical_site_and_readout: Inject post block10; record post block15.
causal_memory_followup.conditions: Zero and both signs at both strengths; original archived v.
causal_memory_followup.schedules: Historical persistent modification of all prefill positions and every decode; plus a last-only-prefill/every-decode schedule to separate prefix breadth from memory evolution. Zero trajectory shared between schedules.
causal_memory_followup.fixed_state_counterpart: Both questions x both precisions x prefill/first-decode x five conditions=40 calls. Change only current last post-block10 output; first decode uses a fresh clone of the untreated prefix's full native state. All compared tokens identical.
causal_memory_followup.interpretation: Contrast local held-state, persistent-last and persistent-all separately. Match actual site updates, parity and precision. Compare sign-even fraction/angle across strength. No pooling as one local derivative experiment and no causal identification beyond the tested controls.

functional_AD_compatibility: Use exact forward-mode AD first. At the FIRST calibration base point only, an unsupported-operator error may select one reverse-over-reverse JVP fallback before any signed output measurements. Freeze the selected AD method; no finite-difference-only substitute, held-out method selection, native-arm retry or extra contexts. One extra unperturbed backbone invocation at most if fallback is needed; record the compatibility failure. Normal whole-backbone count258, maximum259.
preservation: Save every phase/point/prediction and numeric failure incrementally. Source/plan/code hashes frozen before native evaluation. Immutable old studies and stopped study09 unchanged. Private artifacts/checkpoints only, no ordinary public Git data/weights, no OneDrive writes, no new chat/agent/schedule. Verify archive/member hashes and private Drive backup; verify owned worker exit.
